$description: Project Settings › Raw JSON: `project.json` as it is written, and the way through to editing it as text. The adapter (`surfaces/settings-rawjson.ts`) hands in the serialisation the save chokepoint itself produced, so what is drawn is what a save writes rather than a second pretty-printer that would disagree with the file by an indent. The button opens the SAME tab in the Code editor — one document, three editors (`studio.md` §9.3) — so switching to the text and back keeps one undo stack instead of forking two.

style.$description: Two of the rules this section borrowed are gone rather than moved. `.settings-field-desc` styled the sentence under the title, and it is kept here because there is no `jx-field` in this section to draw it — a `<pre>` is not a control and wrapping one in a row would give the file a label it does not need. `.settings-edit-as-code` set `align-self: flex-start` on the button, which did nothing: its parent carried `.settings-section`, a class no stylesheet defines, so there was no flex container for the declaration to be about — and `jx-button` is `inline-flex`, so it already sits at the left of a block.

& [part=\"intro\"].$description: The sentence under the title. Its size read `--spectrum-font-size-75` with a 12px fallback, a name that resolves only inside `<sp-theme>`; a document is mounted in the settings pane, so the fallback is all it could ever have taken and the size is the kit's scale now.

& [part=\"file\"].$description: The file's name, said in the prose as the file it is. It borrowed a bare `<code>` element and whatever the page happened to give one; a document's styling is its own, so the face is stated here.

& [part=\"json\"].$description: `project.json` as it is saved. It scrolls in its own box: a 250-line file must not push the "Edit as code" action off the bottom of the section. Its background read `var(--bg-dim, var(--bg))` and `--bg-dim` is declared nowhere in the token layer, so the fallback is what has always painted it — written as what it resolves to rather than as a name that never resolved.

children: , as it is saved. Editing it as code opens the same document in the Code editor — one undo stack, one dirty flag.
